message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration depicts a dark silhouette of a person standing centered against a backdrop of orange and yellow flames among dark tree trunks. The figure is shown from the knees up, wearing a long coat. They hold their arms raised; the left hand is open, and the right hand holds a long, thin stick like a conductor's baton, which is tipped with a small flame. On the figure's chest, large white block letters read: "TABUR API TUAI ASAP." Below this, smaller white text is legible: "Kebakaran hutan dan lahan dalam tiga bulan pertama tahun ini hampir seluas Jakarta. El Niño dan kisruh tata kelola penanganan api mempercepat bencana kemarau superkering. H.56".

At the top, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, translucent grey letters. Flanking the masthead are two headlines in white: "Pontang-panting Menangani Campak H.26" on the left and "Komando dalam Korupsi Satelit H.34" on the right. Small black leaf-like shapes, some tipped with fire, float in the air. The bottom left contains a barcode and QR code, while the bottom center lists "20-26 APRIL 2026", "RP 60.000", and other publishing details.
